_doc: Full canonical memory loop: identity is bound server-side at connect (/api/convai/bind → convai_voice_bindings), the post-call webhook (/api/convai/webhook) persists via handlePostCallWebhook + distils via distillConversationToMemory for BOTH agents (discovery via aria-memory, investor Morgan via voice-morgan), and the mid-call tool routes (start_conversation / recall_memory / save_memory / save_message / update_topic) are mounted at /api/onboarding/discovery/webhooks/[all] and resolve identity from the bind table. Route guards use CONVAI_TOOL_SECRET. Morgan is a clarifier, so its tool routes are intentionally not exposed to the agent.
